buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder shall have minimum average annual turnover of INR 5 lacs during the last two financial years. The bidder shall submit Following documents: a) Valid FSSAI License b) GST Certificate c) MSME Certificate d) Audited Financial statements required for Last two FYs e) Aadhar and PAN f) 2 Yrs Experience Proof of providing Catering services to Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies. Other Conditions: SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS: 1. Variable Number of Training Programmes and Participants The bidder is hereby informed that the present tender is for the empanelment/engagement of catering ser

vices for various training programmes, workshops and other official events to be organised by the District Health Society, Kathua, under the National Health Mission during FY 2026–27. The requirement is not again st a single, fixed order. The number of programmes may vary, tentatively ranging from 10 to 100 during th e year, depending upon administrative approvals, training permissions and actual requirements. The numb er of participants for each programme may also vary and may not be known at the time of inviting bids. Th e Department does not guarantee any minimum number of programmes, participants or volume of busines s. 2. Mandatory Affidavit/Undertaking by the Bidder The bidder shall submit a duly signed affidavit/undertaking confirming acceptance of the variable nature of the work, the uncertainty regarding the number of programmes and participants, and the obligation to pro vide catering services as and when requisitioned by the Department. The bidder shall also undertake to provide services at the venue/location specified in the relevant event requisition, including locations oth er than the bidder’s usual place of operation, within the District/area specified in the tender. Failure to sub mit the prescribed affidavit/undertaking shall render the bid liable to rejection, subject to the terms of the t ender and applicable procurement rules. 3. Timely Provision of Catering Services and Responsibility for Default The successful bidder shall ensure timely delivery, arrangement and service of food, refreshments and drin king water in accordance with the approved menu, quantity, quality and schedule communicated by the D epartment for each event. In the event of delay, non-supply, incomplete supply or failure to meet the pres cribed requirements, the bidder shall be liable for applicable penalties, recovery of additional expenditure i ncurred by the Department in making alternative arrangements, and other contractual remedies as specifi ed in the tender. Any recovery shall be made in accordance with the contract and applicable rules, after following the prescribed procedure wherever required. 4. Pre-Bid Site Visit and Execution of Agreement The bidder is advised to familiarize itself with the nature and requirements of the catering services before s ubmitting the bid. The successful bidder shall, wherever required by the Department, visit the designated venue and coordinate with the concerned officer before the scheduled event. The successful bidder shall e xecute the prescribed agreement and complete all formalities within the timeline specified by the Depart ment and before commencement of services. The bidder shall not be permitted to refuse or delay an acce pted event requisition on grounds of lack of prior knowledge of the nature of work, venue or operational re quirements, where such details were duly communicated in accordance with the tender conditions. 5. Acceptance of Conditions Submission of the bid shall constitute acceptance of the tender conditions. The successful bidder shall addi tionally furnish the prescribed affidavit/undertaking confirming its unconditional acceptance of the above c onditions and its readiness to provide services against event-wise requisitions issued during the contract p eriod. Any breach shall attract the contractual remedies and penalties specified in the tender, subject to a pplicable procurement rules. .
